transform: G/K/T upper triangles retain exact integer strings and original denominators; symmetry restores lower triangles. F lower scalar and sign witnesses are retained exactly. M is reconstructed from G/K/T/F and compared with a canonical digest of every original M numerator and its denominator. Canonical JSON uses sorted keys and compact separators.
scope: Portable exact saved-matrix arithmetic, not a source-generator replay or complete-domain proof.
